notes:
CRM notes:
- Account: Cygnus Cryptonetworks — payments + fraud detection platform. heavy regulation (PCI scoped), EU products + NA.
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-controlled keys (BYOK) and option for on-prem HSM appliance for sensitive workloads. Must support AWS KMS (CMEK + CloudHSM), Azure Key Vault (Managed HSM), GCP KMS CMEK, and an offline BYOK import flow.
- Crypto/security specifics captured in call: FIPS 140-2/3 attestation required for production keys; HSM attestation report and key origin proof needed. Envelope encryption model ok, but they want key-wrapping logs and per-key rotation schedule (90 days suggested).
- Audit / logging: retention 7 years for key events and access logs. Must integrate with their SIEM (Splunk) via secure log forwarder or S3-like export. Explain how Redwood Private emits audit events and where they land (control plane vs customer VPC).
- Network: all egress must terminate on customer-managed NAT/GW; no public egress for model payloads. Need clarification on outbound endpoints and IP allowlist for control-plane callbacks.
- Latency/throughput targets: conversational latency target p50 <100ms (in-region), sustained 100 rps for risk scoring pipeline — want autoscale and predictable tail latency.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; prioritizing predictable reserved capacity for peak batch scoring. Interested in Optimize recommendations for quantization + batching to reduce token/unit cost.
- POC scope agreed: 1) BYOK flow with AWS KMS + CloudHSM (create key, wrap/decrypt test, key rotation), 2) Azure Managed HSM test in eu-west, 3) audit log export to their S3 and Splunk, 4) failover test to a secondary region (EU->NA) while preserving residency constraints for EU-only datasets.
- Legal / Procurement: requested KMS SLA language + liability carve-outs for key compromise scenarios. Compliance wants a diagram showing where keys live and who has access. Send network diagram and key lifecycle doc (in Drive).
- Quote from CISO: "We need verifiable key origin and full audit trail before we can put any PII on the model."
- Action items (short): technical workshop w/ their crypto team (scheduled wk of 2026-03-22), provide CloudHSM POC playbook, sample HSM attestation templates, draft KMS addendum for legal.
- Risks: their procurement timeline is tight (Q2), and they require an external pentest report for the Private control plane. Also some internal push to evaluate competitor (Anthropic + Cohere) on price.
- Links: security deck + initial SOW in Drive (see linked_drive_docs). Fireflies transcripts for 2026-02-15 and 2026-03-02. Jira INF-4521 opened for BYOK integration questions.
- Notes style: fragments & call snippets preserved from AE/SE notes.
